title: Export the filtered claims list to CSV

fields.summary: As a caseworker, I want to export the claims list I am viewing to CSV, so that I can share it with my manager.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [api-trace] state: claims list filtered by status Open; expected: the downloaded CSV holds exactly the rows the filtered list shows
2. [api-trace] state: export with three visible columns; expected: the CSV header lists exactly those three columns
3. [metric] state: export of 12,000 rows; expected: the page stays responsive, with no main-thread task longer than 200 ms
fields.scenario: Filter the claims list, hide one column, export, and open the file; repeat with 12,000 seeded rows.
